prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE FINAL polished desktop portfolio FIRST PAGE / HERO screenshot, 1536x1024 landscape, flat edge-to-edge actual website. The entire image is ONE coherent first viewport. NO lower project section, about section, footer, mockup device or presentation frame.
User selected these reference designs as favorites and now wants their strongest qualities combined into five final high-end options. Preserve their bold typography, portrait presence, graphic composition and sculptural depth, but create a more deliberate ORIGINAL composition. Professional credibility, visual impact, controlled content and extraordinary type are paramount. This is a portfolio for a real Full-stack AI Engineer, not a design agency or fashion advertisement.
Input Image1 is the authoritative actual portrait identity: Zohaib Haider, dark swept hair, moustache/light beard, black suit, white shirt, dark tie. Preserve exact recognizable face and natural expression. NO glasses, new person, new hairstyle, glamour facial redesign, accessories, stock model or cartoon. Other images are style references of the USER'S SELECTED prior concepts, not replacement faces.
Mandatory identity: 'Zohaib Haider' and 'Full-stack AI Engineer', both easy to find and read. A concise scope line 'AI agents + RAG · Full-stack software · Payments'. A small accurate experience line '2+ years of hands-on engineering'. These are the first-glance evidence; do not add a tool wall or dense diagram. Clear Work / About / Contact navigation and primary 'Explore my work ↗', with restrained secondary 'View résumé ↗'. No fake email, website URL, phone, client, award, salary, user count, revenue, or experience inflation.
Actual work if a single tiny proof teaser is specified: OpsPilot is an AI incident investigation platform using retrieval, agent orchestration, human approval, fine-tuning and voice. HR Intelligence is an Intercom AI support assistant, DSP a driving-school marketplace with Stripe Connect, RTA Marketing automotive CRM and vehicle-data pipelines. Do NOT insert all four case-study cards into this hero.
Typography must feel professionally art-directed: a beautiful contemporary condensed display family with optical spacing, large role/name scales and a refined normal-width sans-serif for readable UI. Never let the portrait hide essential text or cover the face with lettering. No wall of labels or counters. No generic centered résumé layout.
3D AND MOTION LANGUAGE: produce a breathtaking physically plausible RESTING KEYFRAME of an interactive site: clear shallow depth layers, precise soft shadows, a singular sculptural element if specified, intriguing compositing and animation affordances. This output is a STATIC DESIGN IMAGE, not a running animation. The later motion should support the portrait, type and content rather than becoming a disconnected tech toy.
No sci-fi HUD, AI brain, arbitrary neon orb, marble dashboard gallery, origami village, toy control panel, screenshot grids, cramped first page, watermark. The chrome/metal used in the selected Aperture reference is allowed only when specified and should be elegant and restrained.
Direction FOREST: combine the warm sand/forest sophistication of Image2, the compositional tension of Image3, and the sculptural physicality of Image4. Main palette warm sand #EDE4D5, forest ink #0D4537, pale limestone #F4F0E6, one tiny chartreuse #C9DB76. Beautiful tall compressed variable sans-serif, optically balanced, fine normal-width UI text. Calm but unmistakably powerful.
Composition: a precise top header has 'Zohaib Haider' left, small 'Full-stack AI Engineer' adjacent, Work/About/Contact right, with a fine forest rule and one chartreuse marker. HERO typographic architecture: massive 'FULL-STACK' across upper-left/upper-middle at about125px, 'AI ENGINEER' across the LOWER-RIGHT at115px. Keep the actual words fully decipherable. The exact natural portrait is the CENTERPIECE in an original stepped, asymmetric mask about30% width, face perfectly visible. The photo mask has THREE very slim depth-offset ivory backing planes, like a sculpted architectural cutout; the planes gradually recede toward upper-right with gorgeous physically accurate shadows. Not a frame of repeated portraits and not stairs/buildings. Only one actual face.
A singular low-profile matte forest folded-surface accent passes BEHIND the backing planes in the lower-center, close to the mask, partially hidden; it is geometric and refined, not a shiny ribbon or a code bracket. The type, backing planes and portrait form a coherent sculptural identity. On right-mid negative space place a short22px introduction 'AI products. Production platforms. Real integrations.' and smaller scope line. Bottom-left experience in17px. Bottom-right strong forest pill 'Explore my work ↗', secondary underlined 'View résumé ↗'.
Plenty of thoughtful negative space, gorgeous type scale contrast and precise alignment. No extra ornamental badges or project strips. This must be the most resolved, elegant evolution of the sand/forest favorite, not a direct reproduction.
